welcome_html: Welcome to the Downloader Bot! 🤖 Please select your preferred language to read the Terms of Service (EULA). You must accept the terms before using this bot.
eula_text: Terms of Service (ToS) & EULA Clause 1: Nature of the Service This Bot is a technical automation tool that facilitates access to content already publicly available on the internet. The Bot does not store, host, or redistribute files on its own servers permanently. It acts as a transient storage agent. Clause 2: User Responsibility (Safe Harbor) By using this Bot, you declare and guarantee that: 1. You hold the legal rights or permission from the copyright holder to download the requested content. 2. The use of the content is strictly for personal and non-commercial purposes (Fair Use). 3. Developer Exemption: You assume full civil and criminal responsibility for any copyright infringement or violation of third-party platform terms of service (e.g., YouTube, Instagram, TikTok). Clause 3: DMCA Policy and Notification The developer respects intellectual property. Since the Bot does not store content, takedown requests must be directed to the origin platform (where the video is originally hosted). However, if it is proven that the Bot is being used systematically to bypass protection measures, the offending user's access will be revoked. Clause 4: Limitation of Liability The developer will not be liable for indirect, incidental, or punitive damages arising from the misuse of the tool. The service is provided "AS IS". Privacy Policy - We store your Telegram ID only for rate limiting and error logs. - Processed URLs are discarded immediately after download. - Generated files are deleted from temporary servers immediately after successful delivery. - We do not sell or share data with third parties.
disclaimer_footer: This file was processed at the user's request. The developer does not host this content and is not responsible for its future use.

help_text: How to use the Downloader Bot: 1. Send me any URL containing a video, audio, or image to download it. 2. In groups, use the command /dl <URL> so I can see your message. 3. The bot automatically downloads videos in the best possible format and sends them directly to you. Commands: /start - Starts the bot and allows you to accept the EULA. /help - Shows this help message. /usecookies - Upload a `cookies.txt` file to download restricted content from platforms like YouTube or Instagram. /clearcookies - Deletes your securely stored cookies from the database.
